caption: The drawing features a single decorative object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of a cone-shaped base that is mostly pinkish-red in color. Around the upper portion of the cone, there are three layers of frilled ruffles, also in shades of pink and red. Wrapped around the narrow section of the cone, near its middle, is a horizontal band featuring a pattern of small, multicolored flowers in green, blue, yellow, and pink. At the top of the cone, a bow made from the same pink-red material as the ruffles is tied, with two loose ends hanging down. An elongated, twisted loop in the same pink-red color extends upward from the bow, suggesting it is meant to be hung. The composition is centered with no other objects or features in the background, and the lower right corner of the drawing contains a small amount of red text.
title: Emery in the Shape of a Strawberry
